objective: Prevent draft saves and submissions while matching historical applications remain in review, with an owned-application withdrawal shortcut and resumable original action.
users: Release applicants saving or submitting an application with same-window, same-item conflicts

requirements.statement: Draft save and submit must preflight conflicts and must not persist while an in-review conflict exists.
acceptance: No insert or update occurs before blockers clear
counterexample: A blocked second draft exists in the database

requirements.statement: Create, update, and submit must enforce the same in-review gate server-side.
acceptance: Direct API and confirmed conflict token cannot bypass the gate
counterexample: A matching token submits while an old application is in review

requirements.statement: Owned in-review conflicts must offer a card-level withdrawal shortcut when the user has permission.
acceptance: Button appears at card lower right only for owned in-review applications

requirements.statement: Withdrawal requires a reason and continue stays disabled until every blocker leaves in-review state.
counterexample: Continue is enabled while one blocker remains

requirements.statement: Continue must resume the original draft-save or submit action after blockers clear.
acceptance: Submit mode persists and submits only then
counterexample: Continue always submits regardless of original action

requirements.statement: Cancel must return to the form with entered values retained and no persisted new draft.
counterexample: Cancel loses form data or leaves a draft

invariants: Existing workflow withdrawal state machine remains
constraints: Poll only while dialog is open

selected_approach.name: Server-enforced preflight state machine
selected_approach.reason: Avoids invalid drafts and prevents API bypass.

components.name: ReleaseManagementPrototype
components.responsibility: Retain and resume the original action

data_flows.output: No blocked draft or successfully resumed action

error_handling.behavior: Keep continue disabled and show error

security: Tenant, owner, and permission checks remain server-side
performance: Polling runs every two seconds only while blocked dialog is open

verification_strategy.signal: Backend tests prove no persistence and no token bypass
Dialog controls and state transitions match design

assumptions.text: The existing withdrawal lifecycle eventually changes application status to WITHDRAWN.
assumptions.falsifier: Workflow termination event is not delivered

decisions.decision: No draft persistence before blockers clear

risks.mitigation: Show processing state and keep polling while open

approval.evidence: User confirmed the revised preflight design and requested direct implementation on 2026-08-20.
